original_test_intent: Measure every NVIDIA GPU's compute-engine utilization in a defined idle or workload state and evaluate it against the approved contextual policy.
original_method: Record UUID/BDF, driver/tool, active processes and named operating condition; execute the exact utilization.gpu CSV query at the approved cadence/window; retain timestamps, N/A/errors and all devices; apply only the supplied per-GPU range/statistic without launching or changing workload.
manual_activity: Engineering defines idle/load context, sampling window and acceptance policy; the agent can collect and calculate once those parameters exist.
required_inputs: Declared idle or named workload state
safety_requirements: Do not start stress, alter clocks/power or reset GPUs
Do not extend or retry sampling automatically
agent_execution_scope: Collect exact field at approved cadence

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Valid instantaneous metric, but transport and lack of context prevent acceptance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain utilization.gpu and collect timestamped per-UUID samples only for the approved observation window.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source field and all-GPU scope remain; any repeated cadence is an explicit project parameter.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Join utilization samples with UUID, timestamp and process/workload state, then apply the approved rule.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Eliminates judgment from one transient sample without substituting a workload.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: NVML utilization is interval-based and affected by concurrent clients and sampling granularity.

project_override_considerations: The project decides idle versus loaded expectation, cadence, duration and treatment of transients; an idle result cannot stand for stress behavior.
expected_evidence: Raw timestamped utilization CSV and exits

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Command and criterion both concern utilization; the word expected is underspecified but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Safe machine-readable collection exists; missing contextual thresholds affect verdict readiness only.

review_improvement: Prevents a transient utilization percentage from being accepted without device, workload and time-window context.
independent_technical_reasoning: GPU utilization is a sampled busy-time ratio, so its meaning depends on the measurement interval and active workload. Because collection and threshold calculation are machine-readable, missing policy values remain project inputs rather than changing the automation class.
